why: Create a page and change another: the common case
description:
Add a page at /about with the heading "About us" and one short paragraph about the team.

Acceptance criteria:
- Visiting /about shows the heading "About us"
- The /about page has one paragraph of text below the heading
- The home page has a link to /about

why: Change the shared layout, not every page
description:
Add a site footer that appears on every page.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every page shows a footer with the text "© 2026 Agent Playground"
- The footer has a link with the text "Home" that goes to /
- The footer is part of the shared layout, so new pages get it automatically

why: A one-line change: should be cheap and fast
description:
Change the home page heading to "Welcome to Agent Playground".

Acceptance criteria:
- The home page heading reads "Welcome to Agent Playground"
- The old text "Hello from the starter app" no longer appears

why: A client component with state: needs real thinking
summary: Add a like button to the home page
description:
Add a "Like" button to the home page that counts clicks.

Acceptance criteria:
- The home page shows a button with the text "Like (0)"
- Each click adds one: after two clicks it reads "Like (2)"
- The count resets when the page is reloaded (no saving)

why: Must stop at the reader with questions, almost free
description: The site should look better and be more modern.

why: Must stop at the planner: the app has no login system to extend
summary: Show the user's name in the header
description:
Use the existing login system to show the logged-in user's name in the header.

Acceptance criteria:
- A logged-in user sees "Hi, <name>" in the header
- A visitor who is not logged in sees a "Log in" link instead
